download.job.connectionLost: The connection was temporarily lost. Will continue trying.
download.job.createFailed: The download job could not be started.
download.job.error: The download job could not be updated.
download.job.failure.generic: The application could not be downloaded due to an unexpected error.
download.job.failure.limit: The download was blocked because it exceeded a security limit.
download.job.failure.network: The server or network did not allow the download to complete.
download.job.failure.source: Could not obtain a valid installer from the configured source.
download.job.failure.validation: The file received failed security checks.
download.job.linkFailed: Failed to prepare automatic download. Try again with the Get ZIP button.
download.job.receiptFailed: The ZIP is saved. Could not confirm to server; The job will be automatically cleaned when idle.
download.job.manual.body: The ZIP will include .url shortcuts to these applications' official pages.
download.job.manual.title: Download from the official website
download.job.noOfficialPage: This application does not have a secure official page available.
download.job.autoAttempted: The download has been sent to the browser. If it doesn't start, use Get ZIP. The job is cleared after one minute without transfers.
download.job.queuePosition: Position in queue: {position}. Jobs come in on a first-come, first-served basis.
download.job.title: Download job
download.job.apiError.anonymous_active_j: There are already too many active downloads in this session.
download.job.apiError.anonymous_browser_: Too many downloads have been started in a row from this browser.
download.job.apiError.anonymous_ip_rate_: Too many downloads have been started from this network.
download.job.apiError.invalid_job_size: The selection must contain between 1 and 100 applications.
download.job.apiError.invalid_source_sel: The installer selection does not belong to this bundle.
download.job.apiError.selected_source_un: A chosen installer is no longer available for that system. Choose another or use automatic selection.
download.job.apiError.no_downloadable_ap: No selected application has an installer available for that system.
download.job.apiError.service_busy: The download queue is full. Please try again in 30 seconds.
download.job.apiError.storage_busy: Storage is busy. Please try again in 30 seconds.
download.job.apiError.storage_reconcilin: The server is checking storage. Retry the download in a few seconds.
download.job.apiError.download_budget_ex: The estimated space to prepare this work exceeds the total budget of 10 GiB, including temporary installers and the ZIP. Narrow down the selection.
download.job.apiError.storage_budget_exc: The actual space required to prepare this work exceeds the total budget of 10 GiB, including temporary installers and the ZIP. Narrow down the selection.
download.job.apiError.download_size_unav: The required space could not be estimated: source file sizes are unavailable.
download.job.wait.storage_capacity: Waiting for space for this job. Later jobs cannot overtake it.
download.job.wait.storage_budget_wait: The actual size needs a larger reservation. It will be retried in its original position.
download.job.wait.temporary_storage_busy: Waiting for free disk space on the server.
download.overlay.title: Downloads
download.job.issue.httpRevalidation.what: The installer could not be checked with the provider.
download.job.issue.httpResolution.what: The resolution service rejected the request.
download.job.issue.httpDownload.what: The provider rejected the installer download.
download.job.issue.httpDenied.cause: The server denied access with HTTP {status}.
download.job.issue.httpDenied.recovery: Use the official website, where the provider may require access or a manual download.
download.job.issue.httpMissing.cause: The server returned HTTP {status}: the requested resource was not found.
download.job.issue.httpMissing.recovery: Check another catalog source or find the installer on the official website.
download.job.issue.httpBusy.cause: The server limited requests with HTTP {status}.
download.job.issue.httpBusy.recovery: Wait before trying again or use the official website.
download.job.issue.httpOther.cause: The server returned HTTP {status}. A more precise explanation of that response is unavailable.
download.job.issue.httpOther.recovery: Try again later or use the official website. If it continues, keep the issue code.
download.job.issue.sourceMissing.what: The selected installer was not found.
download.job.issue.sourceMissing.cause: The source reference no longer exists in the catalog.
download.job.issue.sourceMissing.recover: Check the catalog options or download from the official website.
download.job.issue.sourceUnverified.what: A valid installer could not be obtained.
download.job.issue.sourceUnverified.caus: The selected source has no usable validation. A more precise cause is unavailable.
download.job.issue.sourceUnverified.reco: Check the other catalog options or open the official website.
download.job.issue.resolver.what: The installer link could not be resolved.
download.job.issue.resolver.cause: The service that checks the source did not return a usable response. A more precise cause was not recorded.
download.job.issue.resolver.recovery: Try again later or download from the official website.
download.job.issue.sourceChanged.cause: An update changed the data while the installer was being validated.
download.job.issue.sourceChanged.recover: Request the download again to check the current data.
download.job.issue.timeout.cause: A complete response did not arrive within the allowed time.
download.job.issue.timeout.recovery: Try again later or use the official website.
download.job.issue.network.what: The download connection could not be completed.
download.job.issue.network.cause: Communication with the server or resolution of its address failed.
download.job.issue.network.recovery: Try again later or open the official website.
download.job.issue.redirect.what: The download link could not be followed.
download.job.issue.redirect.cause: The redirect chain is incomplete, invalid, or exceeds the allowed limit.
download.job.issue.redirect.recovery: Check another catalog option or use the official website.
download.job.issue.integrity.what: The file failed the integrity check.
download.job.issue.integrity.cause: The received content does not match the expected data. It was rejected as a valid installer.
download.job.issue.integrity.recovery: Do not use that file as an installer. Check another source or the official website.
download.job.issue.content.what: The response does not contain a supported installer.
download.job.issue.content.cause: The format, content type, or file signature does not match a valid installer.
download.job.issue.content.recovery: Choose another option or find the installer on the official website.
download.job.issue.security.what: The download destination failed the security checks.
download.job.issue.security.cause: The link does not meet the requirements for public, secure downloads.
download.job.issue.security.recovery: Use another validated source or the official website.
download.job.issue.limit.what: The operation exceeds a download limit.
download.job.issue.limit.cause: The application count, file size, or required capacity exceeds an allowed limit.
download.job.issue.limit.recovery: Reduce the selection or choose a smaller installer. If the limit is temporary, try again later.
download.job.issue.packaging.what: The ZIP could not be prepared.
download.job.issue.packaging.cause: Creation of the ZIP archive or its manifest failed.
download.job.issue.packaging.recovery: Request a new job. If it fails again, keep the code when reporting the issue.
download.job.issue.storage.what: A storage operation could not be completed.
download.job.issue.storage.cause: The server could not read, save, or clean up the job files.
download.job.issue.storage.recovery: Try again later. If the problem continues, keep the issue code.
download.job.issue.missingZip.what: The ZIP is not available for this download.
download.job.issue.missingZip.cause: The server cannot find the job or cannot deliver its file yet.
download.job.issue.missingZip.recovery: Check the job status. If it is no longer available, request a new download.
download.job.issue.delivery.what: The ZIP could not be delivered to the browser.
download.job.issue.delivery.cause: Transfer or saving did not finish correctly. A more precise cause is unavailable.
download.job.issue.delivery.recovery: Use Get ZIP to try again and check the save destination.
download.job.issue.permission.what: The browser could not save the ZIP.
download.job.issue.permission.cause: Access to the save destination was not granted.
download.job.issue.permission.recovery: Use Get ZIP and choose a location where you can save files.
download.job.issue.receipt.what: Delivery could not be confirmed to the server.
download.job.issue.receipt.cause: The ZIP is already saved, but completion could not be confirmed to the server.
download.job.issue.receipt.recovery: Keep the saved file. The server will clean up the job when it becomes inactive.
download.job.issue.sizeUnknown.what: The required size could not be determined.
download.job.issue.sizeUnknown.cause: The sources do not provide enough size information to prepare the job.
download.job.issue.sizeUnknown.recovery: Try a smaller selection or download from the official websites.
download.job.issue.allFailed.cause: Every job item failed and a usable ZIP could not be delivered.
download.job.issue.allFailed.recovery: Check the catalog download options or the official websites.
download.job.issue.connection.what: The connection to job updates was lost.
download.job.issue.connection.cause: The browser is not receiving server updates. The job may still be running.
download.job.issue.connection.recovery: The connection will retry automatically. You do not need to start another download.
download.job.issue.generic.what: The operation could not be completed.
download.job.issue.generic.cause: There is not enough information to determine a more precise cause.
download.job.issue.generic.recovery: Check the job status and keep the code if you need to report the issue.
download.job.issue.cancel.what: The job could not be canceled.
download.job.issue.cancel.cause: The cancellation request could not be confirmed. The job may still be running.
download.job.issue.cancel.recovery: Check the job status before requesting cancellation again.
